category_title: Disengaged students with off-task behaviors and social distractions
minimal_context: The student is working in a small group using an iPad to complete a science assignment.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please work with your small group to complete the science assignment on your iPads.

STUDENT: (Turns away from the assignment to talk to a peer) I'm just trying to understand what was going on with that thing earlier.

TUTOR: Let's do a quick check for understanding on the science material. Wiggle your fingers if you know what to do next.

STUDENT: (Shows a thumbs-down and does not wiggle their fingers)

TUTOR: Okay, just keep trying to figure it out with your group.

STUDENT: (Opens a game on the iPad and looks over to copy off a friend's screen) If I can’t ‘Google’ the answer then I just don’t do it. I try to remember. I usually just wait for the answer.

options.A: Agree with the student that they are having a rough time with the assignment.
options.B: Provide iPad apps that have instant rewards with audio and text.
options.C: Provide a clear beginning and end for each task in the science assignment.
options.D: Move into close proximity to the student during the small group activity.
